message:
Plain words: digging takes only a lamp bulb of power and sips the battery, so the pack budget closes. The cut load 32.9 N from the BP-1 shallow scraper cut force estimate (E9) times 0.500 m per s chain speed needs 16.4 W mechanical from the ladder power estimate (E59), and times 112 s fill to 15 kg from the hopper filling simulation (E11) is 0.512 Wh mechanical per trip from the dig energy estimate (E60), a few Wh electrical after efficiency against the 480 Wh pack from two 24 V 10 Ah Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4, meaning safe long-life rechargeable chemistry) blocks; everyday scale says two minutes of a small bulb against a daily household thousand Wh, so dozens of trips fit. For loosen soil I add the eccentric-mass vibratory cutting edge (C35) as distant analogy to shake the edge free on the same fused bus if draft rises, Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead please note its small motor shares the ladder branch.

Plain words: the bendy frame is fixed by going to two larger square tubes, bringing wobble from a hand width to finger width. Second moment of area (I, meaning shape stiffness of the tube cross-section) is 4.58e-08 m4 for two 25.4 mm square tubes with 3 mm wall from the twin-tube stiffness estimate (E61), giving 3.96 mm tip sag under 300 N half-weight on a 0.500 m rail from the stiffened sag estimate (E63), down from 72.9 mm single-rail sag from the cantilever deflection estimate frame rail (E43); everyday scale says millimetre flex on a suitcase chassis, which passes the millimetre rule Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead and I agreed.

Plain words: the stiffened machine still sits light inside the weight limit and the rear pour sets the pivot load I must carry. Updated mass is 46.0 kg against 60.0 kg leaving 14.0 kg margin from the updated mass sum (E62), about a carry-on bag spare. I take the Skid-Steer Safety for Farm and Landscape (E47) rule that lifting a load transfers weight and raises the Centre of Gravity (CG, meaning balance point of the machine) to mean the rear pivot lugs, tilt motor and power bus must be sized for 15.0 kg soil plus steel at 0.550 m pivot clearing the 0.400 m lip from the tip dump clearance check (E51), so Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead please keep 15.0 kg trips and Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead please keep the level-only dump gate. Ready, because mass, millimetre stiffness and dig energy now survive my deflection and power objections, with only others' arching and fiducial bench tests outside power-structure remaining.
